props.description: The layout of the cards.
The size of the cards.
The amount of space between the cards.
The visual style of the cards.
How selection should be displayed.
The loading state of the CardView.
Handler that is called when more items should be loaded, e.g. while scrolling near the bottom.
Spectrum-defined styles, returned by the `style()` macro.
Provides the ActionBar to render when cards are selected in the CardView.
The contents of the collection.

Whether pressing the escape key should clear selection in the grid list or not.

Most experiences should not modify this option as it eliminates a keyboard user's ability to
easily clear selection. Only use if the escape key is being handled externally or should not
trigger selection clearing contextually.
Whether to auto focus the gridlist or an option.

Handler that is called when a user performs an action on an item. The exact user event depends
on the collection's `selectionBehavior` prop and the interaction modality.
Whether `disabledKeys` applies to all interactions, or only selection.
Whether selection should occur on press up instead of press down.
Item objects in the collection.

The item keys that are disabled. These items cannot be selected, focused, or otherwise
interacted with.
The type of selection that is allowed in the collection.
Whether the collection allows empty selection.
The currently selected keys in the collection (controlled).
The initial selected keys in the collection (uncontrolled).
Handler that is called when the selection changes.

The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
Defines a string value that labels the current element.
Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
Whether typeahead navigation is disabled.

The drag and drop hooks returned by `useDragAndDrop` used to enable drag and drop behavior for
the GridList.
Provides content to display when there are no items in the list.

The primary orientation of the items. Usually this is the direction that the collection
scrolls.

Which item in the collection to focus when tabbing into the collection. Overrides default
roving tab index like behavior.
Values that should invalidate the item cache when using dynamic collections.

A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
